page.overview:
Who is Dr. Lazarus Beam?

Dr. Lazarus Beam was a scientist involved in the development of advanced nanolaser technology. He operated a secret research facility located on an island in the Andaman Sea.

Little is known about Beam's personal life, including his date and place of birth, nationality, education, or family. His exact position within the scientific community is also unknown. Beam became associated with a secret research facility in the Andaman Sea, where advanced nanolaser technology was being developed and tested. The facility was heavily guarded and contained powerful nanolaser generators.

The MI6 became aware of Beam's activities and sent two agents to investigate the facility. The operation began with the agents infiltrating the island and making their way towards the research complex. During the operation, the agents discovered the facility's nanolaser systems. They eventually reached the generators and began shutting them down. The destruction of the facility's systems caused the complex to become increasingly unstable. The MI6 agents escaped before the facility was destroyed.

Beam's fate following the destruction of the research facility is unknown. He is never seen personally during the operation, and the game does not show him being killed. It is therefore unknown whether Beam was present at the facility when it was destroyed or whether he survived.
